set.text: Detached garage conversion to ADU rental requires a building permit, a dwelling-use floor plan, an independent entrance, minimum daylight and ventilation, emergency egress, smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, and a utility connection plan. The one displaced parking space may be satisfied by retaining a driveway-side open space or by an approved shared parking arrangement. Describing the unit as storage, workshop or office to avoid dwelling-use permitting is not allowed.

values.title: ADU zoning interpretation updated
values.body: The guidance on converting a rear garage to dwelling use has been revised. Rely on the current article text and this notice rather than earlier notes.
